title: StepStone fund marks Kong preferred shares near $10.24
summary: An audited fund filing provides an external private-market reference close to the user's later roughly $10 secondary marker. Because it is a Level 3 preferred-share valuation rather than a liquid common-share trade, it does not change the model.
confirmed: StepStone Private Venture and Growth Fund reported 1,211,663 Kong preferred shares at a $12,412,033 fair value as of March 31, 2026, implying approximately $10.24 per preferred share.
The same position had a reported cost of $12,123,382, or approximately $10.01 per preferred share.
uncertain: The share series, liquidation preference, conversion terms, fully diluted capitalization, and valuation methodology for the specific Kong position were not disclosed in the schedule.
The fund mark is not evidence of a current liquid secondary price or an IPO price.
